note: Both sets share the same core defects: an invented quote reading "3%, 5%, and 6%" (which misreads the edgewise damping as 5% instead of the source's 3%), two further damping claims resting on that fabricated quote, and a misbound flatback claim that assigns the midpoint definition to the normalized arc length position rather than to the trailing edge. Set A uniquely recovers the correct damping values (3% flapwise, 3% edgewise, 6% torsional) with genuine quotes, while Set B uniquely captures the composite-layer definition, the IEA Wind Turbine Ontology standard, and the correct flatback trailing-edge definition with its "for flatback airfoils" condition. Each set therefore has four wrong claims and comparable correct coverage — A duplicates the damping facts and drops the "assumed" condition on its correct values, B keeps the condition but never states the correct edgewise value — so the tradeoffs roughly cancel.
